questions.q: Why was the oath sworn to Abraham performed unto Isaac?
choices: Because Abraham obeyed and kept the commandments, statutes and laws
Because Isaac went down to Egypt
questions.explain: Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

questions.q: Who is the seed in 'in thy seed shall all nations be blessed' (Galatians 3:16)?
questions.explain: Through Christ scattered Israel in all kindreds of the earth receives repentance.

questions.q: Why did the Philistines stop Isaac's wells?
choices: Abimelech commanded it for a feast
questions.explain: The nations envy the prosperity of Israel; the blessing itself is what is hated.

questions.q: What did Isaac call the well the herdmen did not strive over?
choices: Rehoboth: for now the Lord hath made room for us
questions.explain: He removed from Esek and Sitnah and digged Rehoboth.

questions.q: Why were Esau's wives a grief of mind to Isaac and Rebekah?
choices: They were Hittites, against the fathers' law of marrying within the kindred
They refused to live in tents
questions.explain: That is the nature of the vessel.
